title: Get TTO video linking requests as a brand
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the requests of a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account for linking creators' public videos to TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/link/status/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{32%}|Type{15%}|Description{53%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{32%}|Type{15%}|Description{53%}| |--- |--- |--- | | tto_tcm_account_id {Required} | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146). | | campaign_ids | string[] | The IDs of existing TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns to filter the results by.

To obtain a list of TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns, use [/tto/tcm/campaign/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693562720258).

Max size: 50. | | handle_names | string[] | The creator handle names to filter the results by.

Max size: 50. | | campaign_type | string | The type of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

Enum values:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: A campaign with a [campaign-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Campaign-level%20invite%20link).
  • `BRAND_LINK`: A campaign with a [brand-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Brand-level%20invite%20link).
If this field is not specified, all campaigns will be returned.| | page | integer | Current page number.

Value range: ≥ 1.
Default value: 1. | | page_size | integer | Page size.

Value range: 1-50.
Default value: 10.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/link/status/?tto_tcm_account_id={{tto_tcm_account_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{32%}|Type{15%}|Description{53%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| video_infos | object[] | Information about the linking requests for videos. | ##| video_id | string | The ID of a creator's public video to be linked to the campaign. | ##| status | string | The status of the request.  

Enum values:
  • `IN_REVIEW`: Sent to the creator and pending the creator's acceptance or rejection.
  • `APPROVE`: Approved by the creator.
  • `REJECTED`: Rejected by the creator.
  • `REVOKE`: Revoked.
| ##| campaign_id | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. | ##| last_reminded_timestamp | string | The last time when the linking request or the reminder notification was sent to the creator, in [ISO-8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

Example: `2025-01-01T00:00:01Z`. | ##| number_of_requests | number | The number of requests for linking the video (`video_id`) to the campaign (`campaign_id`) that you have sent to the creator.

Example: 1. | ##| campaign_type | string | The type of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

Enum values:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: A campaign with a [campaign-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Campaign-level%20invite%20link).
  • `BRAND_LINK`: A campaign with a [brand-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Brand-level%20invite%20link).
| ##| link_request_id | string | ID of the linking request.

You can share the ID with the invited creator so that the creator can use [/tto/creator/link/request/confirm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1837247744649345) to approve or reject the linking request.| #| page_info | object | Pagination information. | ##| page | integer | Current page number. | ##| page_size | integer | Current page size. | ##| total_page | integer | Total number of pages. | ##| total_number | integer | Total number of campaigns. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 10, "total_number": 2, "total_size": 1 }, "video_infos": [ { "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "last_reminded_timestamp": "2025-02-07T21:44:57Z", "number_of_requests": 1, "status": "APPROVE", "campaign_type": "CAMPAIGN", "video_id": "{{video_id}}" }, { "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "last_reminded_timestamp": "2025-02-07T21:12:44Z", "number_of_requests": 1, "status": "REVOKE", "campaign_type": "CAMPAIGN", "video_id": "{{video_id}}" } ] } } (/code) ```
seo_title: Get TikTok One video linking requests as a brand via API
seo_description: Use this endpoint to retrieve the requests of a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account for linking creators' public videos to TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns.
